purpose: Remove premature facts from Svidrigaïlov's first-encounter card and defer them to the end of 22.34.
serialization: json.dumps(indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n' (matches the baseline byte for byte)

operations.old: Wealthy, unsettling, and recently widowed, he pursued Dunya while she worked in his household and is rumored to be responsible for terrible things. His arrival in St. Petersburg alarms the whole Raskolnikov family.
operations.new: Wealthy and unsettling, he pursued Dunya while she worked in his household and is rumored to be responsible for terrible things.

value.editorialBasis: Deferred from svidrigailov-1 by the 2026-09-24 correction; body is the original first-encounter text, unchanged. Marfa Petrovna's death (so his widowhood) is established at 16.73; the rumor that he caused it ("They say he beat her dreadfully") at 17.49; the family learns he has come to St. Petersburg, and is alarmed, at 22.31-22.34 (the reader first meets him there at 20.68). Released at the end of the reviewed source paragraph 22.34, the earliest point at which every clause is supported.
